description: Ticket-number ROI, as fractions of the full ticket image. Applied as sharp.extract({ left: round(w*left), top: round(h*top), width: round(w*width), height: round(h*height) }). Assumes the frontend has already cropped the photo to the ticket edges.

derivation.method: Measured the red-ink bounding box of the preprinted ticket number in each sample, then set the ROI to bound every observed extreme with margin. Red isolated as (G-R) thresholded at 18%.
derivation.source: dt-tickets-prod items having both ticketNumber and rawKey, as of 2026-08-02
notes: Margins are tuned to the extremes of 69 tickets, not a guaranteed bound.
5 of 69 crops register red at the right boundary; that is the dark photo border, not digits.
Supersedes the pre-0faaf29 ROI (left 0.55, width 1-left), which wasted ~40% of its width on blank stock left of the first digit.
